LanguageData.RavenTrap_Beast.label: (Raven) Beast Trap
LanguageData.RavenTrap_Beast.description:
A trap specifically designed to capture wild animals. It emits a special bait scent (generated by consuming organic matter) that attracts untamed wild animals. When an animal steps on it, the trap snaps shut instantly, killing it.

Features:
- Only effective on untamed wild animals.
- Leaves the corpse intact after the kill.
- Requires organic matter (food, meat, etc.) to be loaded as bait, converting nutritional value into usage charges.
